name: Null Lance
description: Throw a lance of pure nothing through the guard of a foe and the body behind it.

name: Nullward Mantle
description: Wrap the user and nearby allies in a mantle of nothing that strips the force from every blow.

name: Great Voidwash
description: Wash every ally in reach of curse and taint and binding in one broad pass of emptiness.

name: Vacancy Press
description: Press a heavy vacancy on the field so that foes cannot raise their qi.

name: Annulling Crown
description: Raise a crown of nothing that burns outward and unmakes the wards of all it touches.

name: Void Absorption
description: Take the whole force of a calamity into the vacancy and leave the field silent.

name: Nothing Phase
description: Pass through walls and wards as if they were not there.

name: Voidseal Edict
description: Stamp an edict of nothing that seals every technique a foe could call.

name: Terminal Silence
description: The school's high rule in which the last silence settles on the field and no technique below a great force can form or land.

name: Unspoken Void
description: The school's quiet judgement in which an unspoken void falls on the field and drains all strength within it.

name: Vacuum Ruin
description: Open a vacuum across the whole field that crushes all within it to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Absolute Absence
description: Remove a chosen person or thing from the world so entirely that no mark or memory of it remains. A successful use is a consequence event.

name: Vacuum Lance
description: Drive a lance of vacuum through ward and body and out the far side.

name: Stillness Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of perfect stillness over allies so no blow completes its motion.

name: Emptying Rite
description: Perform a rite of emptying that lifts the deepest curse or erosion from an ally.

name: Crushing Quiet
description: Bear down with a quiet so heavy that foes cannot lift their hands.

name: Hushed Rend
description: Rend a foe from within with a stroke that makes no sound and meets no ward.

name: Absorbing Nothing
description: Take a ruinous strike into the nothing and let it leave no trace.

name: Voidfold Flash
description: Fold the vacancy and arrive at any point in sight in the space of a blink.

name: Vacancy Decree
description: Decree an emptiness over the field in which lesser techniques are simply not allowed to be.

name: Eternal Hush
description: The school's lasting hush in which the vacancy holds the field still for as long as the user's reserve endures.

name: Unwritten Step
description: The school's passage through the vacancy in which the user steps where no step is written and no blow can follow.

name: Nothing Sovereign
description: The school's ruling gesture in which the vacancy takes the shape of a throne and weighs down every will in sight.

name: Vacancy Sunder
description: Sunder the field with a vacancy that reaches the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Absolute Unmaking
description: Unmake a whole field so that what stood in it never was and the world closes over the gap without a seam. A successful use is a consequence event.

name: Unwritten World
description: Strike a single law from the record of a place so that for a time the law does not hold there. A successful use is a consequence event.
